S01: A huge sailing ship with sails plies the middle of the boundless ocean.
S02: Doctor Lemuel Gulliver stands on the deck and gazes toward the horizon.
S03: The sky suddenly darkens and the sea grows restless.
S04: The sailors run across the deck and battle with the rigging.
S05: A huge wave overturns the ship.
S06: Gulliver struggles in the water and is lost in the darkness.
S07: Dawn breaks on an unknown sandy beach.
S09: Thousands of tiny ropes fasten him to the ground.
S10: Gulliver is bound, and around him stand tiny little people.
S11: He was surrounded by an army of very small soldiers with bows and arrows.
S12: Whenever he stirred, they pricked him with their little swords.
S13: Thus Gulliver arrived in the kingdom of Lilliput.
S14: The tiny people spoke an unknown language.
S15: With a look and a gesture, Gulliver showed them he was hungry.
S16: They brought many little trays full of food.
S17: And many little barrels of wine.
S18: Fed and weary, Gulliver slowly fell asleep.
S19: The next day he awoke in a large building.
S20: Everything around was incredibly small: people, houses, carriages, animals.
S21: Every day tiny cooks brought him food.
S22: And tiny tailors sewed clothes for him.
S23: Little by little, Gulliver learned their language.
S24: Then he asked if he could meet the king.
S25: Gulliver: "Your Highness, I beg you, let me go home."
S26: King: "We will release you, if you help us defeat the Blefuscudians."
S27: A small neighboring island, Blefuscu, with which they had warred for decades.
S29: With them he caught all the ships of the enemy fleet.
S30: The victory of Lilliput was secured.
S31: King: "Now you will help us conquer Blefuscu and enslave its people!"
S32: Gulliver: "No. I will not enslave anyone."
S33: The king's enraged soldiers wanted to kill him.
S34: So Gulliver fled to the enemy island.
S35: There he was received with gratitude, not war.
S36: After some time, he sighted a ship's hull in the sea.
S37: He asked his little friends to help him bring it to shore.
S38: Together they dragged the hull out and began to repair it.
S41: The Blefuscudians and their king gave him many gifts.
S43: Gulliver: "Now my countrymen will believe me when I tell them this incredible tale."
S44: Gulliver: "And I shall never forget you!"
S45: Gulliver raised the anchor and departed for home.
S46: The little kingdoms remained behind him, on the horizon.
S47: Before him stretched the open sea and the road to England.
S48: Thus ended the incredible journey of Doctor Gulliver.
